attempts.summary: Created and enabled a systemd service `inventory-worker` on node1 that runs a long-running heartbeat loop, hardened with NoNewPrivileges=true, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=true, ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory (plus PrivateTmp/PrivateDevices/CapabilityBoundingSet= etc.), running as a dedicated unprivileged system user. Confirmed confinement empirically (write outside /var/lib/inventory fails with the sandbox applied, write inside succeeds) and completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service re-enabled itself, resumed as 'active/running' with the same hardening settings, and continued appending to /var/lib/inventory/inventory.log with data from before the restart intact.
